title: Band Of Berserkers - Auto Battle game - Graphics done via AI
author: Practical-Raccoon-88
selftext:
Hi Guys

  
Busy with this new game - Band of Berserkers. I have not yet made a Steam page. Still early days. I code myself, but leave the graphics up to AI. Some of the "graphics" I do myself. I use ComfyUI on my home PC running Qwen2511 and lighting lora 4 step to make the main pixel art characters. then do an animation video with an AI model. then cut the video into frames, then remove the background and use that as the animation in my 2D game.

What do you think of this? You run a viking clan of warriors. Try to defeat all the Jars in their tournaments to become the king of Norway. 

There is item progression. Loot, Skills, Levels, Permadeath, Money, Unlocks, The AI automatically use their skills "correctly" based on their attacking or defensive intelligence number.

  
Lots to do still, but made this in 2 months.

Would love some feedback.

comments.author: MeasIIDX
comments.body: Seems like a neat game. The character details page is quite dense with a lot of elements that aren't uniform so it's a bit jarring on the eyes. Keep it up!
